searchText: I hope this is the right channel for this question. Is there any documentation that describes how to define the domain value when signing a Voluntary Exit message? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#domain-types I have the DOMAIN_TYPE value, but my confusion is around what values get included when defining the domain value. I had been including the current fork version, but that stopped working some weeks ago. I’ve seen other implementations include the current fork version and previous fork version. I may also be misunderstanding the requirements around defining the domain. Am I incorrect in assuming the values used to derive the domain must be consistent? From this point forwards, voluntary exits are signed with the capella fork. This remains true for future forks (which wasn't the case before).
